components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one amber action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #F0B341; color: #101A33; font: 600 16px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 250ms ease, box-shadow 250ms ease, background-color 250ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #F6C25E; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -12px rgba(240, 179, 65, 0.6); } .ds-btn:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0B341; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Letter Rows
components.description: The recipient's list. Today's letter is the one lit paper row; locked letters are dashed.
components.html: The day we meet againSealed until then
components.css: .ds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px; background: #0B1430; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(233, 236, 242, 0.12); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); color: #A9B3C6; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } button.ds-row:hover { border-color: rgba(233, 236, 242, 0.3); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0B341; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font: 16px/1.35 'Literata', Georgia, serif; color: #E9ECF2; } .ds-row-sub { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 13px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #A9B3C6; } .ds-row--new { background: #F6F3EA; border-color: #F6F3EA; } .ds-row--new .ds-row-title { color: #1B2536; } .ds-row--new .ds-row-sub { color: #5A6070; } .ds-row--locked { cursor: default; border-style: dashed; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F0B341; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(240, 179, 65, 0.2); }

components.name: Letter Paper
components.description: A letter on night: cream paper, amber halo, Literata body, a strip of tape.
components.html:
Written 21 days before your flight

To Daniel

You practiced ordering coffee in Korean at breakfast and you were terrible at it. I’m going to miss hearing you be terrible at things.
components.css: .ds-night { padding: 32px 20px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #050A19 0%, #0B1430 60%, #101A33 100%); } .ds-paper { position: relative; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px; border-radius: 12px; background: #F6F3EA; color: #1B2536; box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(240, 179, 65, 0.08), 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 50%; width: 88px; height: 22px; background: rgba(240, 179, 65, 0.7); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg); } .ds-meta { margin: 0; font: 13px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #5A6070; } .ds-title { margin: 6px 0 14px; font: 400 26px/1.2 'Literata', Georgia, serif; } .ds-body { margin: 0; font: 18px/1.8 'Literata', Georgia, serif; }

components.description: The planning guide speaks on paper, in serif.

What’s one small thing about them you never want to forget?

components.css: .ds-chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 20px; background: #0B1430; } .ds-msg { max-width: 86%; margin: 0; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 18px; font: 16px/1.6 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-msg--ai { align-self: flex-start; background: #F6F3EA; color: #1B2536; border-bottom-left-radius: 6px; font: 17px/1.6 'Literata', Georgia, serif; } .ds-msg--me { align-self: flex-end; background: rgba(233, 236, 242, 0.1); color: #E9ECF2; border-bottom-right-radius: 6px; }

narrative.overview:
Someone is still thinking of you in the dark. The whole product lives at night: a deep navy sky, cool moonlit text, and a single warm amber light that marks the one thing worth doing next. Letters are the only bright, warm surfaces. They sit on the night like paper under a desk lamp, with a faint amber halo around them. Everything else is quiet chrome that gets out of the way.

Time is the material. The landing walks through a day, from late night through before dawn, morning, afternoon and dusk, back to evening, with a sundial marking the hour and the sky changing behind each scene. The builder, diary and recipient box stay in the night. Motion is slow and unhurried (1000ms reveals, 250ms lifts, a gentle cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) ease) and turns off completely under reduced motion.

The letter itself is crafted and tactile: paper variants, washi tape, stamps, postmarks, pressed flowers, die-cut vinyl stickers and handwritten Caveat notes. The interface around it is soft and calm, never pushy.
keyCharacteristics: Night-first. Navy gradients from night to night-surface, never flat black.
One warm light. Amber (light) is the single accent: primary action, focus, today's letter, the seal.
Paper glows. Cream paper surfaces carry ink text and an amber halo.
Literata for anything the heart says, Schibsted Grotesk for anything the interface says.
Pills and soft corners, 44px+ touch targets, mobile-first column widths (560–720px).
Unhurried motion, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent. One amber primary action per view; everything else is mist, paper or ink. If two things glow, neither does.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Warmth Rule
rules.body: Warm, bright surfaces are reserved for letters and the things that hold the sender's words. UI chrome on night stays translucent mist (rgba(233, 236, 242, 0.03–0.08)), never cream.

rules.name: The Retired Rose Rule
rules.body: The cream-and-rose palette from before the night redesign (warm creams, dusty rose, brown text, DM Sans, Playfair Display) has been removed from the code. Don't bring it back. src/index.css holds only the night body background, and the Tailwind theme stays empty.

rules.name: The Heart and Hands Rule
rules.body: Serif for what the sender or the product says to a person (headlines, letters, the guide's chat replies, row titles). Sans for what the interface says (labels, buttons, help, meta). Never set a letter in sans or a button in serif.

rules.name: The No Tracking Rule
rules.body: Headlines get slight negative tracking (-0.01 to -0.03em). Nothing is uppercase-tracked. Labels stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element is at least 44px tall. Primary buttons and inputs are 48–52px.

rules.name: The Light, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: On night, a surface earns prominence by being lit (paper, amber), not by casting a darker shadow. Never put a heavy shadow on a translucent mist card.

dos: Do build every new screen on the night gradient (night → night-mid → night-surface) and reserve warm surfaces for paper.
Do keep amber to one primary action per view, plus focus and "today" signals.
Do set headlines and letter text in Literata, and interface text in Schibsted Grotesk.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more, and text inputs at 16px.
Do use the shared ease cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), and kill all animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use a 2px amber :focus-visible outline offset 3px on night.
Do keep text visible at rest. Scroll reveals move the text, they never hide it.
donts: Don't use the retired cream/rose palette, DM Sans, or Playfair Display in new work.
Don't introduce a second accent color, or tint UI chrome cream or amber.
Don't put heavy shadows on translucent night cards. Light lifts surfaces here, shadow doesn't.
Don't use Caveat outside handwritten notes, tickets and scrapbook captions.
Don't use flat pure black (#000) backgrounds or alarm-red errors.
